set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 4 Hardening.

45 unrelated refusal types; I/O errors are hashed ('cannot read path (reason <checksum>)'); storyBuild exits 0 on an unvalidated draft. Related: the progressive facade bead bd-01M1DD1KVSVNK35C4Y9XPMSEHX.

Scope:
Error ergonomics and the one-call path.

Acceptance criteria:
1. One refusal supertype carrying message and path, adopted by the public refusal types (listed in the commit).
2. I/O errors report the exception class and path, without source prose.
3. A one-call facade maps a corpus descriptor plus transcripts to a mapping; it is documented and its docs-site example verifies.
4. storyBuild exits non-zero, or with a distinct documented code, on an unvalidated draft.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 4: hardening -- refusal supertype, readable I/O errors, facade around recall-map
